nodes.name: U.S. Secret Service
nodes.scope: Financial crime and protective remit; not military command.

nodes.name: FBI
nodes.scope: Federal investigation and domestic national-security laws; no presumption of case transfer.

nodes.name: CIA
nodes.scope: Foreign intelligence under lawful oversight; not a domestic police function.

nodes.name: U.S. Military / DoD
nodes.scope: Defense policy, civilian harm mitigation, assistance governance and lawful support.

nodes.name: Commerce BIS / OEE
nodes.scope: Export controls and specialized compliance; not DoD military investigation.

nodes.name: U.S. Department of State
nodes.scope: Diplomacy, security assistance/end-use oversight and legal foreign-policy channels.

nodes.name: United Nations
nodes.scope: Civilian protection and diplomacy under multilateral mandate.

nodes.name: ICRC
nodes.scope: Neutral humanitarian mandate; never used as an intelligence handoff.
